summary: Measured audit-driven speed-up of the pytest suites: unit quick wins (event-wait bug, de-subprocess, watcher waits), pytest-xdist for CI Stage 1/matrix, batching integration parse-checks into one Godot session, integration timeout/playtest tuning, and E2E smoke wait fixes. Numeric targets: unit 40.7s->15s, integration 5:10->2:30, e2e smoke 1:59->1:15, coverage never reduced.
